import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static Map<BitSet, Integer> nodeIdMap = new HashMap<>();
    static int N, totalNodes;
    static int[][] P = new int[7][7];
    static long[][] dpState = new long[2][70003];
    static int[][] transTable = new int[70003][128];
    static long[] probArray = new long[128];
    static long inv100;

    static int modPow(long base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }

    static int dfs(BitSet x) {
        if (nodeIdMap.containsKey(x)) return nodeIdMap.get(x);
        int id = ++totalNodes;
        nodeIdMap.put((BitSet) x.clone(), id);
        BitSet[] tmp = new BitSet[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            tmp[i] = new BitSet(1 << N);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                if (((j & (1 << i)) != 0)) {
                    tmp[i].set(j | (1 << i));
                } else {
                    tmp[i].set(j);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            BitSet temp = (BitSet) x.clone();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    temp.or(tmp[j]);
                }
            }
            transTable[id][mask] = dfs(temp);
        }
        return id;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        BitSet start = new BitSet(N);
        start.set(0);
        totalNodes = 0;
        nodeIdMap.clear();
        int startId = dfs(start);
        inv100 = modPow(100, MOD - 2);
        System.err.println(nodeIdMap.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
            probArray[i] = 1;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                int pVal = ((i & (1 << k)) != 0) ? P[i][k] : 100 - P[i][k];
                probArray[i] = (probArray[i] * inv100) % MOD * pVal % MOD;
            }
        }

        dpState[0] = new long[70003];
        dpState[1] = new long[70003];
        Arrays.fill(dpState[0], 0);
        Arrays.fill(dpState[1], 0);
        dpState[0][startId] = 1;
        int currentLayer = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dpState[currentLayer ^ 1], 0);
            for (int j = 1; j <= totalNodes; j++) {
                if (dpState[currentLayer][j] != 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << N); k++) {
                        int t = transTable[j][k];
                        dpState[currentLayer ^ 1][t] = (dpState[currentLayer ^ 1][t] + dpState[currentLayer][j] * probArray[k]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            currentLayer ^= 1;
        }

        BitSet finalMask = new BitSet(N);
        finalMask.set(0, N);
        int finalId = nodeIdMap.get(finalMask);
        System.out.println(dpState[currentLayer][finalId]);
    }
}
